svg.title: Working with coding agents
svg.desc: Three panels. One person, one agent: the person waits and one task moves at a time. One person, many agents by hand: every prompt, check and approval goes through the person. ensemble: the person talks to managers, and each manager launches, watches and reports on its workers.
svg.text: Simple, but you wait: one task at a time.
next starts when this one ends
Every prompt, check and approval goes through you.
You talk to managers; they launch, watch and report on workers.
